title: Crop Health & NDVI Anomaly
subtitle: Multi-year standardized z-score deviation from 3-year baseline
key_finding: 85.6% of cropland displays normal or above-normal vegetative vigor. Localized moisture or delayed transplanting stress is restricted to 14.4% (372.2 ha), primarily on tail-end irrigation distributaries.
method: Standardized NDVI anomaly z-scores computed against multi-year seasonal reference distributions. Negative anomalies (z < -0.5) identify water stress, delayed transplanting, or localized pest attack, while positive anomalies (z > 0.5) indicate robust canopy development.
limitations: Cloud contamination during heavy Northeast Monsoon weeks (Nov–Dec) can momentarily depress optical composites before synthetic radar cross-calibration kicks in.
